summary: ESS Tech, Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a registered direct offering of 6,400,000 shares of common stock at $0.50 per share, raising $3.2 million before fees, alongside a concurrent private placement of warrants to purchase up to 12,800,000 shares at the same exercise price. Roth Capital Partners acted as exclusive placement agent receiving 7% cash fees and placement agent warrants. This is an ordinary equity capital raise, not a special situation. No strategic event, acquisition, or restructuring is involved. The filing reflects routine financing activity and warrants no special-situations classification.
